description: Curated FRED/ALFRED macro-financial panel (national accounts, prices, labor, rates and Treasury yield curve, credit spreads, money, bank credit, Fed balance sheet, housing, industrial production, trade, fiscal, FX, commodities; state unemployment/payrolls/income/GDP/HPI/population) with real-time vintage metadata on every observation

source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED/ALFRED)
source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). Most series are US government data; series whose notes name third-party copyright holders (Moody's, ICE, S&P, CBOE, University of Michigan, Freddie Mac, NASDAQ, ...) are flagged in config.json series[*].third_party_copyright and on each observation (attributes.third_party_copyright). Internal use only; do not redistribute flagged series.

acquisition.description: One FRED API observations request per (series, real-time window) listed in config.json; every series requests every ALFRED vintage (windows of <=1900 vintage dates, split into offset slices of 100,000 observations where a window has more rows). Combinations are generated by build_config.py. desired_bytes (840 MiB) matches the measured 800 MB artifact plus headroom; the superseded truncated and partial artifacts were deleted after this one verified.

sampling.reason: Full acquisition only (FRED API key required); anchor samples live in fred_cpi and the other fred_* datasets
